headline: A calmer, safer way to work in every project

features.title: New threads stay in the right project
features.description: Start a conversation in the project's default workspace, or choose a specific branch or worktree when you want to continue focused work.

features.title: Add projects with a simple drop
features.description: Drop a folder into the project picker to add it safely, with clear feedback when the drop is outside the picker.

features.title: More reliable provider sessions
features.description: OpenCode and Kilo sessions recover more predictably when a turn finishes, a server exits, or a connection needs attention.

features.title: Open local files with confidence
features.description: Preview supported local files in a protected viewer while keeping existing Markdown previews and project boundaries intact.
